description: EffectCraft: An open-source motion graphics and compositing tool written by scratch in pure Rust

latest_release.name: EffectCraft v0.22.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* OCIO config: a mismatched closing bracket ends a flow collection; multiline flows parse in linear time by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2939
* Roto Brush: keep frozen mattes in a session without their model (#2833) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2834
* Import: EDL source timecodes land on each file's own time (#2832) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2835
* Lottie: read the closed flag older Bodymovin files keep outside the path by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2842
* Text animators: a later animator's Opacity can show characters an earlier one hid by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2843
* Lottie: warn when embedded glyphs (`chars`) are not imported by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2847
* Import: BT.2020 PQ and HLG video gets the Rec. 2100 profile (#2849) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2852
* G2: --save runs on one project take turns, so no edit is lost by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2872
* Export: H.264, HEVC and AV1 tag the frames' own colour (#2879) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2881
* Viewer: the Rotation tool turns a child around its own anchor by @barchukmov in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2887
* Puppet: a click where the deformed layer is empty creates nothing by @barchukmov in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2891
* UI: Composition Settings widens to fit a longer translation (#2841) by @ljkx in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2892
* SAM 2: read the wgpu env variables and refuse adapters without compute shaders (#2900) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2905
* Layer and item names: a second layer or a copy of v-b1.mp4 is v-b1.mp4 2 (#2904) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2908
* Text animators: say that animator indexes count from 1 (#2907) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2909
* Match Grain: take no sample box beside transparent pixels (#2919) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2922
* material.set: name the Material Options a layer doesn't have (#2917) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2924
* Panels: the panel menu stays as wide as its contents (#2864) by @barchukmov in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2933
* Panels: the gutter keeps rows clear of the scroll bar (#2867) by @barchukmov in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2934
* Viewer, Timeline: a middle-drag pans and moves no layer (#2854) by @barchukmov in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2935
* Cryptomatte eyedropper: pick IDs in the viewer from the Selection (#473) by @MatejKozlovsky in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2957
* 3D Camera Tracker: Effect Controls say how many frames a partial solve solved (#2959) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2960
* Effect Controls: Shift-click selects a range of effects by @barchukmov in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2962
* i18n(ja): the work area is ワークエリア in the panel too by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2978
* Pre-compose: layers left behind drop links to moved layers; default names are numbered by @nanox333 in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2979
* Render Queue EXR sequences are scan-line, not tiled (#2805) by @HEOJUNFO in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2812
* test(cli): a child that exits before draining stdin breaks the write, not the test by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2819
* 3D Camera Tracker: a partial solve is not reported as solved (#2822) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2824
* Motion Tile: mirror folds sample the edge texel, not the transparent outside (#2820) by @rahul05ranjan i

detail.readme_excerpt:
EffectCraft

Motion graphics and visual effects; an open-source, professional motion graphics and visual effects studio, built in pure Rust.

A free, open-source compositor: compositions, layers, keyframes, 308 effects, layer styles, expressions, 3D cameras and lights, and a render queue, native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser. Young, moving fast, and already usable.
